signals.title: feat: agent skills for deploying BentoML services to Kubernetes, EC2, and SageMaker
signals.text: ## What this PR does With BentoCloud winding down, this adds a set of **Claude Code agent skills** (under `.claude/skills/`) that give users a fully open-source path from a local BentoML project to a running service on infrastructure they own: the `bentoml` CLI, Docker, `kubectl` with plain manifests, `ssh`, and the AWS CLI. No Helm, no operators/CRDs, no Yatai, no closed-source dependencies. | Skill | Purpose | |---|---| | `bentoml-containerize` | project → `bentoml build` → `bentoml containerize` → local smoke test (content-verified) → push to Docker Hub / GHCR / ECR / private registry / kind / minikube / ttl.sh | | `bentoml-k8s-deploy` | pushed image → parameterized Deployment/Service(/Ingress) manifests rendered into the project's `k8s/` → `kubectl apply` → rollout verified with a real inference request | | `bentoml-k8s-troubleshoot` | decision-tree runbook for 10 common K8s failure modes (image pull, crash loops, OOM, Pending/GPU, probes, stuck rollouts, networking, 4xx/5xx, rejected manifests, port-forward false positives) | | `bentoml-ec2-deploy` | pushed image → Docker on one or more plain EC2 instances (existing via SSH, or provisioned via AWS CLI with SSM AMI lookup) → tunnel-verified inference → teardown | | `bentoml-sagemaker-deploy` | service adapted to the SageMaker BYOC contract (port 8080, `/ping`, `/invocations`) with a small validated patch → ECR → model/endpoint-config/endpoint → `invoke-endpoint` verified → teardown | Scope is intentionally **basic deployment only** — BentoCloud-era features (autoscaling on inference metrics, canary, scale-to-zero) are out of scope for every target; standard building blocks (HPA, ALB, SageMaker autoscaling) get one-line pointers. `.claude/skills/README.md` is a full user guide: five-skill overview, a target decision flow with comparison table, prerequisites matrix, installation walkthrough (personal vs per-project, sparse checkout), per-skill configuration reference, a worked end-to-end example, and prominent cost warnings. The AWS skills show every mutating command with a cost note and require explicit confirmation before creating anything; each has a complete teardown section scoped to session-created resources. ## How it was validated - Every claimed BentoML CLI/server behavior verified against this repo's source; every AWS CLI command verified against aws-cli 2.13.28 help + AWS docs. - K8s path: full e2e on a real k3s cluster (build → containerize → push → deploy → correct inference through port-forward). - EC2 path: full e2e on a real AWS account — t3.micro provisioned via the skill (SSM AMI lookup, SG, key pair), ECR pull, tunnel-verified correct inference, verified clean teardown. - SageMaker path: the adaptation patch proven locally including an exact container-level simulation of the SageMaker launch contract (`docker run -e BENTOML_PORT=8080 IMAGE serve` → `/ping` 200, `/invocations` correct); ECR push exercised for real; endpoint CLI syntax probe-validated. The endpoint-creation leg needs an account with a SageMaker execution role (the skill now includes an AccessDenied branch with a ready-to-send admin snippet for exactly that situation). - Each skill passed an independent adversarial review with fix-and-re-review loops before landing. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

signals.title: fix: Windows tar symlink extraction and fastai CI dependency resolution
signals.text: Fixes the three classes of CI failure currently red on `main`: 1. **unit-tests (windows)** — `test_from_fs_preserves_safe_tar_symlink` fails with `OSError: [Errno 22]`. Safe tar extraction creates symlinks with POSIX-style targets; Windows cannot resolve forward-slash link targets. Fix: normalize the linkname separator on Windows (`src/bentoml/_internal/utils/filesystem.py`) + platform-agnostic readlink assertion. 2. **framework-integration-tests (fastai)** — pip backtracks to a versioneer-era fsspec sdist that no longer builds on Python ≥ 3.12. Fix: `fsspec>=2023.1.0` floor in `noxfile.py`. 3. **all python3.9 jobs (since 2026-08-14)** — pdm 2.28.1 (released 2026-08-11, picked up by the unpinned `pipx install pdm`) crashes `pdm sync` against py3.9 target environments. Fix: pin `pdm==2.28.0` in `ci.yml`. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
